cms_model_proposal.notes: Headline is deliberately split into 3 separately-animated lines; keep 3 fields rather than one rich heading, otherwise the title-move-animation breaks. Only line 1 is an <h1>.

The heading is masked by N .text-overlay row-0N divs (7 present). Generate those in Blade from a configurable line count, or drop them and animate with CSS, otherwise editing the copy misaligns the reveal.

4 rows: 325+/Clients Worldwide, 975+/Projects Completed, 50+/Team Members, 85M+/Revenue Generated. Values are not stored in one node in the HTML — each digit is a 10-item scrolling reel column. Blade must render the reels from value+suffix. Reusable on about.html / why-choose-us.html, so make it a real table, not a singleton.
Replace the Webflow w-json lightbox blob with a plain video_url field and render your own lightbox; the embedded embedly html carries a third-party api key.

4 items on home, all currently linking to the single services-details.html. Shared with service.html and services-details.html — needs slug-based routing. counter (01..04) should be derived from sort_order, not stored.
3 featured on home; full list lives on casestudy.html and detail on case-study-details.html. Home should query featured limit 3.
Section wrapper copy only. Must keep the literal DOM id "case-study" — the hero round badge links to #case-study.
Also appears on about/why-choose-us with a different wrapper class (home-page-process-title modifier); consider a shared section record keyed by page.

4 rows: Marketing Plan, Analyze, Execution, Growth & Scale. step_number should derive from sort_order. First item carries the extra class margin-left-none — render that on index 0 in Blade, do not store it.

5 rows. In the HTML name+role is one string and company is a nested <span class="lowercase-regular">; split into name/role/company columns and re-compose in Blade. Tab ids (w-tabs-0-data-w-tab-N / w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-N) must be generated from the loop index so adding a testimonial does not duplicate ids.
Export has the 3rd tab active (data-current="Tab 3"); default_active_index should be settable and default to 0.
